field.label: Enabled
field.help: Include this filter in filters.inc. Disabled filters are not loaded by BIRD.

field.label: Name
field.help: BIRD filter name (must be unique). Must match the include file name without .inc, e.g. filter_refilter → /usr/local/etc/bird/filter_refilter.inc. Use this name in a peer Import field.

field.label: Community
field.help: Optional BIRD community define name (same as the community include without .inc, e.g. community_ANTIFILTER_DOWNLOAD).

field.label: Address family
field.help: Selects default-route match (0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0) and the default TUN define if Interface is empty.

field.label: Reject default route
field.help: Reject 0.0.0.0/0 (IPv4) or ::/0 (IPv6) before accepting other prefixes.

field.label: Interface
field.help: BIRD identifier assigned to ifname (e.g. ACTIVE_TUN4_IF). Leave empty to use ACTIVE_TUN4_IF or ACTIVE_TUN6_IF from the address family.
